Announced successions are sometimes delayed or rescinded between announcement and effective date, and nothing verified in the record is a primary, dated confirmation that the handover actually occurred on that date: the only 'completed transition' reports are secondary outlets (Hypebeast, AndroidHeadlines, and Al Jazeera, which is undated in the evidence table and dated only by URL inference), no SEC 8-K (Item 5.02) has been pulled, no post-1-September capture of Apple's leadership page was checked, and the uploaded apple_ceo_memo.png is undated, of unknown provenance, and under test is never proof of itself. There is even a metadata inconsistency — the apple.com release is logged as published 2026-08-19 while its URL path reads 2026/04 — which shows the record set was assembled loosely. If the transition slipped past 1 September or was called off, the claim as stated ('became Apple's CEO on 1 September 2026') would be materially wrong. That said, this case is weak: three independent outlets dated 1 September 2026 report the handover as done, so FALSE is a distant runner-up behind TRUE.
